questions.stem: A can do a piece of work in 30 days and B can do it in 40 days. In how many days can they do the work together?
questions.keySolution: A’s efficiency = 1/30 per day - B’s efficiency = 1/40 per day - Combined efficiency = 1/30 + 1/40 = 4/120 + 3/120 = 7/120 - Time = 120/7 = 17.14 days

questions.stem: A can do a work in 12 days. B can do it in 18 days. How many days will they take if they work together?
questions.keySolution: A’s efficiency = 1/12 per day - B’s efficiency = 1/18 per day - Combined = 1/12 + 1/18 = 3/36 + 2/36 = 5/36 - Time = 36/5 = 7.2 days

questions.stem: A and B together can finish a work in 20 days. A alone can finish it in 30 days. In how many days can B alone finish the work?
questions.keySolution: Combined rate (A+B) = 1/20 per day - A’s rate = 1/30 per day - B’s rate = 1/20 - 1/30 = 3/60 - 2/60 = 1/60 - B takes 60 days

questions.stem: X can do 1/4 of a work in 10 days. How many days will X take to complete the entire work?
questions.keySolution: If 1/4 work takes 10 days - Full work takes 10 × 4 = 40 days

questions.stem: A is twice as good a worker as B. If B takes 20 days to complete the work, how many days will A take?
questions.keySolution: A is twice as good as B - If B takes 20 days, A takes 20/2 = 10 days - (More efficient means less time)

questions.stem: A, B and C can do a work in 8, 12 and 24 days respectively. How many days will they take working together?
questions.keySolution: A’s rate = 1/8, B’s rate = 1/12, C’s rate = 1/24 - Combined = 1/8 + 1/12 + 1/24 = 3/24 + 2/24 + 1/24 = 6/24 = 1/4 - Time = 4 days - Actually: Let me recalculate with LCM = 24 - 1/8 + 1/12 + 1/24 = 3/24 + 2/24 + 1/24 = 6/24 = 1/4 - So 4 days is correct. The answer should be B) 4 days.

questions.stem: A takes twice as much time as B to complete a work. If together they can complete it in 12 days, how much time will B take to complete it alone?
questions.keySolution: Let B’s time = x, A’s time = 2x - Combined: 1/2x + 1/x = 1/12 - (1 + 2)/(2x) = 1/12 - 3/(2x) = 1/12 - 2x = 36, so x = 18 - B takes 18 days

questions.stem: A and B can build a wall in 10 days. B and C can build it in 12 days. A and C can build it in 15 days. How many days will A take alone?
If 10 men can do a work in 15 days, in how many days can 6 men do the same work?
questions.keySolution: 10 men × 15 days = 6 men × x days - 150 = 6x - x = 25 days

questions.stem: A man and a boy can do a work in 12 days. The man alone can do it in 18 days. In how many days can the boy alone complete the work?
questions.keySolution: Man + Boy = 1/12 per day - Man = 1/18 per day - Boy = 1/12 - 1/18 = 3/36 - 2/36 = 1/36 - Boy takes 36 days

questions.stem: A works at 2/3 of his normal efficiency. If he completes the work in 18 days at this reduced efficiency, how many days would he take at normal efficiency?
questions.keySolution: At 2/3 efficiency, takes 18 days - At normal efficiency = 18 × (2/3) = 12 days

questions.stem: A can do 40% of work in 10 days. In how many days will A complete the entire work?
questions.keySolution: 40% work in 10 days - 100% work = 10 × (100/40) = 25 days

questions.stem: A and B together finish a work in 15 days. A alone can finish it in 20 days. B alone will finish the work in how many days?
If A and B together can do a work in 10 days and B alone can do it in 20 days, in how many days can A do it alone?
3 men and 4 boys can complete a piece of work in 12 days. 4 men and 3 boys can do the same work in 10 days. Then, 2 men and 3 boys can finish the work in how many days?
A works at 5/4 times his normal efficiency. If he completes work in 8 days at this efficiency, how much time will it take at normal efficiency?
questions.keySolution: At 5/4 efficiency, takes 8 days - At normal efficiency = 8 × (5/4) = 10 days

questions.stem: A, B, and C working together can complete a work in 6 days. A and B together can complete it in 9 days. In how many days can C alone complete it?
Ravi is twice as fast as Ajay in doing work. Together they finish it in 12 days. How many days will Ravi take alone?
questions.keySolution: Ravi is twice as fast as Ajay - Let Ajay = 2x, Ravi = x time - 1/x + 1/2x = 1/12 - 3/(2x) = 1/12 - 2x = 36, x = 18 - Ravi takes 18 days

questions.stem: A can complete 1/3 of a work in 5 days. In how many days can he complete the full work?
questions.keySolution: 1/3 work in 5 days - Full work = 5 × 3 = 15 days

questions.stem: If 8 men working 10 hours a day can complete a work in 20 days, how many days will 5 men working 8 hours a day take?
A and B can complete a job in 10 days and 15 days respectively. They work on alternate days with A starting first. In how many days will the job be completed?
questions.keySolution: A does 1/10 per day, B does 1/15 per day - In 2 days: A does 1/10, B does 1/15 = 1/10 + 1/15 = 3/30 + 2/30 = 5/30 = 1/6 - In 12 days = 6 pairs of 2 days = 6 × (1/6) = 1 - So 12 days is answer

questions.stem: Manoj takes twice as much time as Anjali and thrice as much as Amit to finish a piece of work. Together they finish the work in 1 day. What is the time taken by Manoj to finish the work?
questions.keySolution: Let Manoj = x, Anjali = x/2, Amit = x/3 - 1/x + 2/x + 3/x = 1 - 6/x = 1, x = 6 days

questions.stem: 4 men and 6 women can complete a work in 10 days. 3 men and 7 women can complete it in 10 days. In how many days can 5 men and 5 women complete it?
questions.keySolution: Both equations give 1/10, so 4m+6w = 3m+7w - This means m = w in efficiency - 5m + 5m = 10m (equivalent) - Combined rate = 10/100 per day = 1/10 - Time = 10 days

questions.stem: A completes a work in 24 days. B is 60% more efficient than A. In how many days can B complete the work?
questions.keySolution: A takes 24 days - B is 60% more efficient = 1.6 times faster - B takes 24/1.6 = 15 days

A man completes 5/8 of a work in 10 days. In how many more days will he complete the remaining work at the same rate?
6 men can complete a work in 9 days. In how many days can 18 men complete the same work?
questions.keySolution: 6 men × 9 days = 18 men × d - 54 = 18d, d = 3 days

questions.stem: A is 50% more efficient than B. If B takes 30 days to complete the work, how many days will A take?
questions.keySolution: A is 50% more efficient = 1.5 times faster - B takes 30 days - A takes 30/1.5 = 20 days

A, B, and C can do a work in 10, 15, and 20 days respectively. In how many days will they complete the work together?

A works at 3/4 of his normal efficiency. If he takes 16 days to complete the work, how many days will it take at normal efficiency?
questions.keySolution: At 3/4 efficiency, takes 16 days - At normal efficiency = 16 × (3/4) = 12 days

questions.stem: If A can do 1/5 of a work in 4 days, how many days will A take to complete the full work?
questions.keySolution: 1/5 work in 4 days - Full work = 4 × 5 = 20 days

questions.stem: B takes 50% more time than A to complete a work. If together they take 24 days, how long does A take alone?
A completes 3/5 of a job in 6 days. In how many days will the remaining job be completed at the same rate?
questions.keySolution: 3/5 work in 6 days - 2/5 work = 6 × (2/3) = 4 days

If 3 men and 4 women can do a work in 12 days, in how many days can 6 men and 8 women do the same work?
questions.keySolution: If we double men and women: 2× efficiency - Time becomes 12/2 = 6 days

questions.stem: A, B, and C can complete a work in 12 days. A and B together can do it in 15 days. In how many days can C alone do it?
A is 3 times as efficient as B. If B alone takes 30 days to complete a work, how long will A and B together take?
questions.keySolution: A is 3 times efficient as B - If B = x, A = 3x time - 1/(x) + 3/x = 1/d - But efficiency is inverse, so: 3/x + 1/x = 1/d - If B takes 30 days: 1/30 is B’s rate - A’s rate = 3/30 = 1/10 - Combined = 1/30 + 1/10 = 1/30 + 3/30 = 4/30 = 2/15 - Time = 15/2 = 7.5 days

questions.stem: A man does 1/3 of a job in 10 days. In how many days will the remaining job be completed?
questions.keySolution: 1/3 in 10 days - Full = 10 × 3 = 30 days - But remaining 2/3 = (2/3) × 30 = 20 days

questions.stem: If A and B working together can complete a work in 10 days and B and C together can do it in 15 days, what can be concluded about the work rates?
options: A is more efficient than C
C is more efficient than A
questions.keyValue: A is more efficient than C
questions.keySolution: A+B = 1/10 (faster) - B+C = 1/15 (slower) - Since same B, A must be more efficient than C

questions.stem: A completes a work in 12 days. B completes it in 15 days. If they work together for 3 days, what fraction of work remains?
questions.keySolution: A’s rate = 1/12, B’s rate = 1/15 - 3 days work = 3(1/12 + 1/15) = 3(5/60 + 4/60) = 3(9/60) = 27/60 = 9/20 - Remaining = 1 - 9/20 = 11/20 - Closest is D) 7/20, but calculation gives 11/20

A is twice as good a workman as B. If A and B working together can complete a work in 9 days, in how many days can A alone complete it?
